about:
AID3S is jointly organized by Centro Escolar University, Manila, Philippines and SPJ Centre for Multidisciplinary Research (SCMR) in Centro Escolar University, Manila from 26 to 28 February, 2027.
Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) are transforming the way complex problems are designed, analyzed, diagnosed and solved across computing, engineering, healthcare and industrial applications. Advances in deep learning, generative AI, intelligent optimization, computer vision, natural language processing and autonomous systems are creating new opportunities for innovation across multiple domains.
The International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Design, Diagnostics and Decision Systems (AID3S 2027) aims to provide an international platform for researchers, academicians, industry professionals and practitioners to present and discuss recent advances in AI methodologies and their applications in computing, biomedical engineering, core engineering disciplines and emerging technologies.
The conference invites original research contributions addressing theoretical foundations, novel algorithms, computational methods, intelligent systems and real-world applications of AI and ML. Particular emphasis will be placed on the integration of AI into engineering design, intelligent diagnostics, predictive modelling, optimization, decision support and autonomous systems.
objectives:
To promote research in AI, ML and advanced intelligent computing.
To encourage the application of AI methods to complex engineering and biomedical problems.
To facilitate interdisciplinary collaboration among researchers in computing, engineering, healthcare and applied sciences.
To explore trustworthy, explainable, responsible and deployable AI systems.
To foster collaboration between academia, research institutions and industry.
publication:
The conference organizers intend to explore suitable publication opportunities for selected papers, subject to the scope, quality requirements and independent acceptance procedures of the relevant publisher or proceedings series.
Publication in **Springer proceedings** or any other publisher's series is **not guaranteed**. Details will be announced only after the relevant publication arrangements have been formally confirmed.
participate:
Researchers, faculty members, scientists, doctoral scholars, postgraduate students, industry professionals and practitioners working in AI, ML, Computer Science, biomedical engineering and other engineering disciplines are invited to participate.
We welcome interdisciplinary contributions that demonstrate how AI and ML can advance design, diagnostics, prediction, optimization and decision-making in real-world systems.
Join AID3S 2027 to share research, exchange ideas and advance intelligent solutions across computing, engineering and applied sciences.
footerAbout: Artificial Intelligence in Design, Diagnostics and Decision Systems — bringing together researchers, academicians and industry professionals to advance intelligent solutions.
guidelines:
Papers must be original, unpublished work and must not be under review elsewhere.
Submit your paper as a PDF of at most 10 MB.
At least one author of every accepted paper must present the work.
